brief_title: Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of PB-201 in Treatment-naive Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
official_title: A Multi-center, Randomized, Double-Blinded, Parallel, Vildagliptin and Placebo-Controlled Phase III Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of PB-201 in Treatment-naive Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
brief_summary: This is a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, parallel, Vildagliptin and Placebo-Controlled study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of oral administration of 100 mg of PB-201 in the morning and evening in treatmentnaive patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus.
